IBM Plex Sans and IBM Plex Mono
===============================

Copyright (c) 2017 IBM Corp. with Reserved Font Name "Plex"

Licensed under the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1. The full licence text
is in LICENSE.txt in this directory: IBM's own LICENSE.txt, identical in both
packages below (the repository's .gitattributes stores it with LF line endings;
the text is otherwise unchanged). Because of the Reserved Font Name, the files
below are IBM's own prebuilt Latin woff2 files, vendored unmodified
(byte-identical to the files in IBM's npm packages): never subset, convert or
otherwise edit them. They are not Fontsource or Google Fonts builds.

Vendored file                              Path inside the npm package
-----------------------------------------  --------------------------------------------------------
ibm-plex-sans-latin-400-normal.woff2       @ibm/plex-sans  package/fonts/split/woff2/IBMPlexSans-Regular-Latin1.woff2
ibm-plex-sans-latin-500-normal.woff2       @ibm/plex-sans  package/fonts/split/woff2/IBMPlexSans-Medium-Latin1.woff2
ibm-plex-sans-latin-600-normal.woff2       @ibm/plex-sans  package/fonts/split/woff2/IBMPlexSans-SemiBold-Latin1.woff2
ibm-plex-mono-latin-400-normal.woff2       @ibm/plex-mono  package/fonts/split/woff2/IBMPlexMono-Regular-Latin1.woff2
ibm-plex-mono-latin-500-normal.woff2       @ibm/plex-mono  package/fonts/split/woff2/IBMPlexMono-Medium-Latin1.woff2

These are IBM's "Latin1" split files (normal style): Basic Latin, Latin-1
Supplement and the common typographic punctuation. IBM publishes further
subsets as separate files (Latin2, Latin3, Pi, Greek, Cyrillic), none of which
Yuzu vendors. Characters outside the Latin1 file (for example the arrows in
the Pi file) fall back to the next family in the font stack.

---------
SHA-256 and size in bytes:
  b5ad7bd39f996144915f0ad9849a90183b27d8c28ad97ed98af5b1bebc51f6b1  20984  ibm-plex-sans-latin-400-normal.woff2
  b5610af04d0d4b5a14a621d96d974b993e945a065db1a8861918f69ef9321934  21960  ibm-plex-sans-latin-500-normal.woff2
  fff0ab3a88b0b4aa0b693e4f0201359a15183b08e3fa5696d1918d8f0ade8ad5  22260  ibm-plex-sans-latin-600-normal.woff2
  e8993d946649b9d01abb1ed06d574b19d8ea3e66b5c3948602db335c44c18e56  17544  ibm-plex-mono-latin-400-normal.woff2
  41201b658a328b9d00368215c2f1102770f80b15952ab82631e4006255e6365d  17868  ibm-plex-mono-latin-500-normal.woff2

Recompute with `shasum -a 256 server/core/vendor/ibm-plex/*.woff2`. The test
suite pins each file's byte count (see kExpectedPlex in
tests/unit/server/test_static_js_bundle.cpp). When refreshing the upstream
release, update the versions and hashes here and the byte counts there in
lock-step.
